name: Deploy to EC2

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main  # O la rama que prefieras

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Check out the code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Log in to Docker Hub
      uses: docker/login-action@v2
      with:
        username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
        password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

    - name: Build the Docker image
      run: docker build -t ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/vl-learning_backend:latest .

    - name: Push the Docker image
      run: docker push ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/vl-learning_backend:latest
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build  # Esto asegura que el job de deploy espere al job de build
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Deploy to EC2
      uses: appleboy/ssh-action@master
      with:
        host: <ip>
        username: ubuntu
        key: ${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}  # Clave SSH almacenada como secreto en GitHub
        script: |
          docker login --username ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }} --password ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}
          cd /home/ubuntu/backend
          docker-compose down
          docker-compose pull  # Para actualizar la imagen si fue reconstruida
          docker-compose up -d
